svg.title: Scenario-conditioned diffusion transformer architecture for denoising trajectories
svg.desc: Complete editable SVG reconstruction. Base frames: scenario inputs, encoder, decoder, denoising-step column, bottom diffusion transformer, and nested frames for scene, scenario crops, transformer layers, and thumbnails. The drawing inventories visible content: roadway scene snapshots, neighbors/navigation/lanes/static-object inputs, arrows into encoder mixers and self-attention, decoder diffusion transformer, iterative denoising snapshots, bottom transformer pipeline with ego/neighbors state, attention blocks, layer-normalization/scale/FFN blocks, timestep diamond, and scenario/diffusion/navigation conditioning arrows. No SAM picture assets are available; all content is constructed natively with SVG.

g.desc: Origin is the large scene snapshot at left. To its right are neighbors above navigation; lanes and static object are further right. Grey wedge points from scene to scenario crop set. Three black arrows carry scenario inputs to encoder MLP/MLP/MLP blocks.

The encoder frame contains three stacked input processing blocks at left: two MLP-Mixer blocks and one MLP block. They feed a self-attention block at right with a thin bracket and a pale blue repeated-layer container marked xN.
Decoder includes a small purple latent box, a diamond node, and a rounded orange diffusion transformer block. A vertical return arrow enters the transformer from below via the encoder/condition hook.

Right panel stacks four road-scene snapshots arranged vertically. Green dots represent noisy samples and dark vehicles become progressively cleaner from top to bottom. A black downward time arrow is at far right, labelled t, with Denoising Step at bottom.

Navigation crop drops down, bends right into an MLP-Mixer condition block, then feeds the top conditioning bus. Static/condition arrows continue into the bottom transformer. A diffusion timestep bus is summed with the navigation condition and linked to the timestep diamond.

The bottom origin is the left input state block x^(t), with tau arrow above and ego/neighbors labels. Conduction proceeds right through LN, scale-shift, multi-head attention, scale, LN, scale-shift, FFN, scale, repeated layer, final layer, and output x^(t-Δt). Scenario condition is a long line along the bottom with an open circle at the left. The whole section has left-to-right symmetry between attention and feed-forward sub-blocks, with repeated down arrows from conditioning bus.
